prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1043; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows front-quarter damage on the driver side, including a cracked bumper cover, a bent front fender support, and a broken headlamp assembly, with scraping that runs toward the wheel well. The pattern lines up with the impact described for a left turn into oncoming traffic. Repair will involve replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the fender support, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and no earlier damage to this vehicle is known from our records. The invoices submitted contain no repeated charges, and the parts list matches the work described.
